move.text:
Dear partner,
Many thanks for your reply; we really appreciate the chance to work with you.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €17.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.
Please let me explain.
We appreciate your volume projection; kindly provide the historical data or firm orders that substantiate the 6,000 pieces per year.
Please note that it is our strict company policy not to disclose internal cost breakdowns, though we assure you our pricing remains highly competitive.
Transitioning to DAP and reducing lead times would necessitate a price increase; therefore, we propose maintaining EXW terms to offer a reduced price of €15.90.
Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 45 days and delivery EXW: €15.90 per unit.
Which volume can you commit to?
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
